subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 77 (Teacher's exhibit cards (objects only: the crystal fountain, a steam hammer, the Koh-i-Noor, a printing press))
intro: Lesson 77: Planning a diary entry: a day at the Great Exhibition. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

cards: The crystal fountain: a fountain made of glass, taller than a house, standing at the centre of the Crystal Palace. Water sparkled as it fell.
A steam hammer: a huge machine that could strike with tremendous force, yet so controlled it could crack an eggshell gently.
The Koh-i-Noor: one of the largest diamonds in the world, shown in a gilded cage. Crowds queued to see it.
A printing press: a fast machine printing thousands of sheets an hour, so news could reach more people than ever.
